title: A Space owner can buy a new domain inside Frequency and have their website on it with no DNS step

source.ref: The buy method slot in DOMAIN_METHODS (owner ask 2026-10-06: ability to buy a domain); white label sites build ADR-1708

detail: FILED 2026-10-06 by owner ask ("I also want ... ability to buy a domain"). THE CONSEQUENCE: a client without a domain has to buy one elsewhere and then do the DNS step. THE FIX: the 'buy' method in lib/sites/domain-methods.ts over Vercel's registrar API: search and price a name, take payment through the checkout contract (lib/billing/checkout-ui.ts + checkout-panel, docs/CHECKOUT.md), then purchase on Frequency's Vercel team, attach it to the project and bind it to the Space (domains bought on the team use Vercel DNS, so no records are needed). Needs a record of each purchase for renewal and transfer-out. LIFT: L, about 10 files (registrar client, search and price action, checkout wiring, purchase webhook step, renewal job, panel UI, tests), ONE migration (a space_domains purchase table: domain, space, price, renews_at, status, with RLS). Vercel's Registrar API sells at cost (upstream name.com) with auto-renew and an auth code for transfer-out; the end customer is the registrant (contactInformation), so the domain is theirs. OWNER STEPS: confirm with Vercel that buying on behalf of customers is allowed, a pricing ruling (pass-through or markup, who pays renewal), and the Vercel team's payment method covers the purchases. Probe flips when the method is available. BUILT 2026-10-06 (owner rulings that day: a small markup over Vercel's at-cost price, the Space pays renewals, and the whole purchase path behind a switch that defaults OFF). The buy method in DOMAIN_METHODS is built (available: true) and waits on the operator switch `domain_purchase_enabled` (platform_flags, default off, read with billing_live through domainPurchaseEnabled in lib/pricing/settings.ts); while it is off the Domain section shows Buy a new domain as Coming soon. lib/sites/registrar.ts is the Vercel Registrar client (availability, one-year price, buy with the end customer as registrant, order status) on the one platform token and team (VERCEL_API_TOKEN, VERCEL_TEAM_ID); it never throws and logs no token or contact detail. lib/sites/domain-pricing.ts: Frequency price = Vercel price + markup in whole cents, shown as one yearly price with the renewal price. THE MARKUP SETTING: pricing_settings key `domain_markup` ({cents}), default 300 ($3 a year), clamped to $100, edited in /admin/pricing under Domain sales beside the switch. lib/sites/domain-purchase.ts: the Space pays through a mode:'payment' Checkout routed through lib/billing/checkout-ui (kind domain_purchase, price re-quoted on the server, pending row written before the session is handed back); only after Stripe confirms payment (webhook recordPaidCheckout, or settleDomainPurchaseAction from CheckoutPanel onPaid) does the settle claim the row with one conditional update (pending -> purchasing), buy at Vercel at the quoted price, record the order, purchased_at and renews_at, then bind spaces.domain (only when empty) and attach it with addSiteDomain, so DNS is automatic. A retried webhook claims nothing and buys nothing. If Vercel refuses after payment the Space is refunded under domain-purchase-refund:<id>. Vercel auto-renew is on only when the Space has a saved card; the renewal charge loop and the order reconcile are LIVE-786. ONE migration, supabase/migrations/20270346003100_space_domain_purchases.sql (service role only, RLS on with no policy, both client roles revoked; seeds domain_markup and domain_purchase_enabled off). NOT APPLIED: check:migrations parity stays red until the owner applies it, and check:schema-contract carries one allowlist entry that retires on the next types regeneration. OWNER STEPS: (1) confirm with Vercel that buying domains on behalf of customers is allowed; (2) make sure the Vercel team's payment method covers the purchases; (3) apply the migration and regenerate lib/database.types.ts; (4) with billing live, turn on Buy a new domain in /admin/pricing > Domain sales and set the markup if not $3.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('lib/sites/domain-methods.ts','utf8');const m=s.match(/key: 'buy'[\s\S]*?available: (true|false)/);if(!m||m[1]!=='true'){console.error('LIVE-781: buying a domain is not available yet (DOMAIN_METHODS buy.available is false)');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails today: the buy method is listed as coming. Passes when it is built and switched on.
